headline: Gladbach's worst start meets a Stuttgart side strong in Europe
summary: Gladbach arrive at Stuttgart on Friday with 0 points from six Bundesliga games — the worst start in their history — and they are conceding 2.17 expected goals per game. They have let in 17 goals in their last five league matches. Stuttgart are unbeaten in the Champions League with 7 points, but only 13th in the Bundesliga on 6. The market average makes Stuttgart 69.8% favourites, more than five times Gladbach's 13.7%, and it expects 3.75 goals. Stuttgart may also be without right-back Vagnoman, who has played 778 minutes this season.
